title: PISCO: Precise Video Instance Insertion with Sparse Control
abstract: arXiv:2602.08277v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The landscape of AI video generation is undergoing a pivotal shift: moving beyond general generation - which relies on exhaustive prompt-engineering and "cherry-picking" - towards fine-grained, controllable generation and high-fidelity post-processing. In professional AI-assisted filmmaking, it is crucial to perform precise, targeted modifications. A cornerstone of this transition is video instance insertion, which requires inserting a specific instance into existing footage while maintaining scene integrity. Unlike traditional video editing, this task demands several requirements: precise spatial-temporal placement, physically consistent scene interaction, and the faithful preservation of original dynamics - all achieved under minimal user effort. translated_title: PISCO：基于稀疏控制的精确视频实例插入
translated_abstract: AI视频生成领域正在经历一场关键的转变：从依赖详尽提示工程和“精心挑选”的通用生成，转向细粒度的可控生成与高保真后处理。在专业的AI辅助电影制作中，执行精确的、有针对性的修改至关重要。这一转变的基石是视频实例插入，即在保持场景完整性的同时，将特定实例插入现有素材中。与传统视频编辑不同，该任务需要满足多项要求：精确的时空放置、物理一致的场景交互，以及对原始动态的忠实保留——所有这些都需要在最小化用户操作的前提下实现。在本文中，我们提出了PISCO，一个用于精确视频实例插入的视频扩散模型，支持任意稀疏关键帧控制。PISCO允许用户仅指定单个关键帧，
tldr: PISCO是一个支持稀疏关键帧控制的视频扩散模型，能够将特定实例精确插入现有视频中，同时保持场景完整性、物理一致性与原始动态，且仅需极少的用户操作。
en_tdlr: PISCO is a video diffusion model that enables precise video instance insertion with arbitrary sparse keyframe control, preserving scene integrity, physical consistency, and original dynamics with minimal user effort.
